findings.1_x_really_reads: CONFIRMED by the reviewer's own capture, not by re-reading the executor's. Fresh run x_try2 sealed 2 real posts (251 B and 689 B), evidence count equals items, both body hashes recompute from the stored bytes to the claimed sha256, page_complete false, next_cursor observed_tail:2106688975465586698, and the SQLite cursor is revision 2 with covered_until null, opaque_cursor set and pending_window_from 2026-09-29. Wiring confirmed at internal/domain/sources.go:300-304 (case "X" -> sources.XBrowser{Runner: BrowserActCLI{Executable}, BrowserID}) and adapters/sources/x.go drives browser-act only through public article fields. The pre-registered browser exists and is described as the receipt claims.
findings.2_partial_pages_keep_the_prefix: CONFIRMED, and stronger than the executor proved. Against the real pre-fix bytes (whole files from 2e69022e) TestW0702XGapKeepsPrefixAndResumeCursor and TestW0702PartialPageSealsItsVerifiedPrefix both go red for the named reason, so the tests are not vacuous; the executor's M1/M2 replay as caught. The reviewer's two extra mutants: the domain's negative half is caught (a page with nothing complete that seals a manifest fails TestW0702FailedPageWithNothingCompleteStillSealsNothing), but reverting the two DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE gap sites in the adapter survives the whole TestW0702 family - see problem P3.
findings.3_the_card_answers_its_own_check_id: CONFIRMED by measurement. ops/ci/sources.py:294-302 whitelists check in {W07-G01, W07-G02, ""} and case in {"", A05}; forwarding W07/W07-02/ returns rc 1 with {"status": "NOT_IMPLEMENTED", "assertions": 0, "error": "unbound W07 selection"}, as do W07-G99 and case XYZ. routing() serves W07-02 only when case is empty, and W07-02+A05 falls to legacy and is refused.
findings.4_obligation_R3_closed_without_widening_: CONFIRMED. forward('W07','W07-G01','') reaches a real child report: rc 0, status PASS, 23 assertions, 7.2 s. Mode is derived per selector with an empty default, and unbound selectors still refuse (three cases measured). The gate is not widened.
findings.5_registry_append_and_attribution: CONFIRMED independently. Registry 18 -> 19, 21 keys, identical key order, only test.sources.live differs, and only in selectors.check_id [W07-01] -> [W07-01, W07-02] plus an append-only note; the other 20 selectors re-serialise identically; argv/env/timeout unchanged; no other key's roster mentions W07-02, so nothing was rerouted. Re-runs: dispatcher.selftest PASS 30, contracts.validate PASS 136, package.validate_v24 PASS 12. build.check TIMEOUT rc 8 attribution holds: the key is W02-03-owned (task_id [W02], check_id [W02-03], argv apps/cli/build_check.py, 600 s), disjoint from this key, and it had already timed out three times earlier the same day with the identical empty-stdout/empty-stderr shape; the receipt's '15:24Z append' timestamp is loose (the registry commit is 15:43:05Z) but the conclusion is right.
findings.6_accepted_card_W07-01_still_green: CONFIRMED at the reviewer's hand: invocation f75c65ac, PASS, 23 assertions, 0 failures, both live captures green (GITHUB 2.78 s, PAPER 16.87 s). No red to classify. The two edits to that accepted card's file are judged legitimate later-card-in-scope corrections: the ROUTING_TABLE row that was changed is the row about W07-02's own selector (not one of W07-01's acceptance claims), the routing addition is required because the shared dispatcher key points at that one program, and the X-environment withdrawal is filed as a NEW receipt rather than rewriting accepted bytes. But see P4 for sentences the correction left standing.
findings.7_no_laundered_refusal: The green run is not laundered. Three injected states all fail closed with the full 20-row roster: browser-act executable missing -> status FAIL rc 1 with 6 X rows red; unregistered browser id -> status FAIL rc 1 with 6 X rows red; pinned go missing -> status FAIL rc 1. In the reviewer's own red run the refused PAPER kind took its four rows down with it instead of being skipped. One per-kind row (W0702-*-NO-FALSE-COMPLETE) is nevertheless satisfied vacuously by a kind that read nothing - see P8.
findings.8_disclosed_not_claimed: The disclosure is accurate and, if anything, slightly under-credited. internal/domain/research.go:156-245 does build per-source source_coverage (status PARTIAL, gap_reason, record_count) from cursor state and source_pages.complete, research_acceptance.go:267 puts it in the cycle report, and apps/web/src/screens.jsx:75 and :83 do render cycle.source_coverage in the 来源覆盖 sections; nothing in W07-02 grades those against these captures, and no UI-side assertion for that field exists anywhere in tests/ (only a pass-through in tests/e2e_cycle/_fixture/cycle_test.go:324). The cycle-level status mapping is however already graded by accepted tests the receipt does not mention - internal/domain/research_test.go:159-160 (C06-01 COMPLETE/COMPLETE, C06-02-X NOT_CONFIGURED) and :224 (C06-02-429 RATE_LIMITED) - so the honest statement is 'not graded against these live captures', which is exactly what the receipt says.

problems.label: reservation
problems.statement: The card's own verification command does not reproduce green. This reviewer ran it once on a clean tree at the parked HEAD and got COMMAND_FAILED, exit 1, 20 assertions, 4 red rows - W0702-PAPER-LIVE-READ, W0702-PAPER-EVIDENCE-MATCHES-ITEMS, W0702-PAPER-CONTINUES-WHILE-X-IS-BLOCKED, W0702-PAPER-ITEMS-ARE-INSIDE-THE-WINDOW - all of them the PAPER leg. The receipt attributes the red to 'arXiv timeouts', i.e. environment. Measured, that is only half true and the half it omits is product.
problems.evidence: reviewer invocation 40a7a455-17f1-4cf2-b963-f8b609686b14 (2026-10-04T16:00:48Z) versus executor 69c0fcc6 (PASS). Direct measurement of the same probe.exe, kind PAPER, three runs with HTTP(S)_PROXY stripped (which is what the dispatcher does, because registry allowed_env lists no proxy variable): rc 1 at 31.3 s, rc 0 at 6.1 s, rc 1 at 46.3 s. The failing message is 'context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout or context cancellation while reading body)'; adapters/sources/sources.go:106 sets http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}; the object it must read is https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.03442v2, measured here at 11,947,867 bytes, which another attempt pulled in 1.7 s, and export.arxiv.org/api answered in 1.4 s. The link is therefore not dead; the deadline that fires is the adapter's own constant.
problems.why_not_a_blocker: The 30 s constant predates this card (introduced in commit 674edf4a) and the card neither changed nor claimed to change it. The card's deliverable - a real X read with sealed bytes and a pending cursor, and an explicit product refusal when X is unconfigured - reproduced green in this reviewer's own run, and the red rows are the pre-existing PAPER leg, honestly reported as red rather than skipped. Nothing was laundered into a PASS.
problems.required_before: Before W07-99 treats test.sources.live as a stable gate for the parent's source-health claim: either give the PAPER leg a budget that fits a 12 MB document (the constant sits inside this line's reach at adapters/sources/sources.go:106) or make the check retry in a way that is recorded rather than luck-dependent, and restate the executor's receipt attribution as 'the adapter's own 30 s deadline against a ~12 MB arXiv PDF', not 'environment'. One sentence plus one selector run.

The second (引用一年旧文当近7天) is not exercised anywhere, and the one row that superficially covers it is self-referential: W0702-PAPER-ITEMS-ARE-INSIDE-THE-WINDOW compares item.published_at against the report's own window_from/window_to, and the probe asks a 2023-01-01 -> now window, so a 3.5-year-old paper passes it while the run also claims page_complete true and a covered window.
problems.evidence: Committed green-run evidence qualification/v2.4/evidence/w0702/20261004T153459Z-19936/paper_try1/report-PAPER.json (sha256 df85986073725178..., hash-verified in capture_evidence_manifest_round1.json): item published_at 2023-04-07T01:55:19Z = 1276.6 days before window_to, window_from 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z, row W0702-PAPER-ITEMS-ARE-INSIDE-THE-WINDOW = PASS with outside=[]. The window is chosen at tests/sources/live/main.go:84 and graded at tests/sources/check/main_w0702.py:200-201. No row in the 20 asserts a recency claim, and the adapters' actual window filters (adapters/sources/x.go:113, arxiv.go:153, github.go:119) are asserted by no test this reviewer could locate in adapters/sources/*_test.go, internal/domain/sources*_test.go or x_test.go.
problems.why_not_a_blocker: The card never asserts a 近7天 coverage claim, so it does not commit the counter-example either - it is untested, not falsified, and the recency-shaped window it does use (X: 2026-09-29 -> now) is filtered correctly and graded with two in-window items. The half of the NEGATIVE line that concerns X's own configuration state - the part this card is about - is proven, including by this reviewer's injected variants.
problems.required_before: Before W07-99 signs the parent's source-health claim: add one row, inside this card's own files (tests/sources/live/main.go plus tests/sources/check/main_w0702.py), that requests a genuinely recent window (e.g. 7 days) over a document known to be older and shows the row goes red rather than quietly returning an empty-but-complete page. The filter to be proven already exists in three adapters; only the grading row is missing.

problems.label: reservation
problems.statement: The adapter's partial-page fix was applied at four gap sites (DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE x2, INCOMPLETE_ITEM x2). The executor's M1 mutant reverts only the two INCOMPLETE_ITEM sites, and no test ever drives a DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE gap. A reviewer mutant that reverts the other two sites passes the entire TestW0702 family, so 'a page that stops at a gap keeps its verified prefix and reports how far it read' is pinned for one of the two ways a real X page stops.
problems.evidence: execution/v2.4/receipts/W07/W07-02/reviewer_mutation_round1.json mutant REVIEW-M3-adapter-detail-unavailable-aborts-page: 2 occurrences substituted, mutated_rc 0 ('ok researchos.local/research-os/adapters/sources'), clean_rc 0, restore sha256 matched -> class SURVIVED. The gap-site asymmetry is visible in the card's own diff (git diff 2e69022e..HEAD -- adapters/sources/x.go): pre-fix the DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE sites were 'return p, e' (an error, which makes captureSourcePageBound discard the prefix entirely at internal/domain/sources.go:363-371), not 'return p, nil'. The fake runner in adapters/sources/x_partial_test.go never errors on navigate or eval, so those branches are unexercised.
problems.why_not_a_blocker: The behaviour that is pinned is real and does fail against the true pre-fix bytes, and the surviving sites are the same code shape as the pinned ones; this is an incomplete guard, not a wrong one. It also cannot produce a false PASS in the card's report, because the check grades items and cursors, not which branch fired.
problems.required_before: Before any later card claims X's gap handling is complete: one more case in adapters/sources/x_partial_test.go whose runner fails navigate (or eval) on the second candidate, asserting the prefix, the cursor and Failure == DETAIL_UNAVAILABLE. That converts REVIEW-M3 from survivor to caught; roughly ten lines in a file this card already owns.

problems.label: reservation

A resuming window reads the program, not the receipt.

(d) execution/v2.4/commands.json's scope field for test.sources.live still reads 'the X kind needs an authorized BrowserAct tool and is disclosed rather than simulated', in the very key this card amended.

These are narrative defects, not behaviour defects.
problems.required_before: Before the next card inherits this handler: replace the disproved clause in main.py's X not_verified row and the W07-02 entries in the routing() docstring and diagnostic, and correct the scope sentence in the registry key this card already touches. All four sit in files this card either owns or has already edited.

problems.label: limitation
problems.statement: A partial capture records that the page was incomplete but never why, in any artefact that survives the process.
problems.evidence: The sealed MANIFEST read out of this reviewer's own x_try2/live-X.sqlite carries complete:false, observed_from/to, page_cursor_in/out, request_urls (4) and final_urls (3) - and no failure or gap field. source_pages columns are project, cursor_id, source_id, query_hash, window_from, window_to, page_cursor_in, page_cursor_out, raw_artifact_id, item_refs_json, complete, fetched_at, cursor_kind, artifact_kind - no reason column. tests/sources/live/main.go:51-53 then zeroes report.failure whenever status is PASS, which is why every healthy-but-partial X report in the receipt shows failure: null. The reason is asserted only in the in-memory return value (internal/domain/sources_partial_page_test.go:60, :90).
problems.why_not_a_blocker: Persisting the reason is a schema and cycle-layer change (internal/domain/research*.go, migrations) outside this card's write scope, and the card's own contract test does pin that the caller still sees Failure.
problems.required_before: Not required of this card. Owed to whichever card next owns the cycle/health surface, and it bounds what '健康/覆盖与UI一致' can ever mean at rest.

problems.label: limitation
problems.statement: For X, resume is structurally persistence-only: nothing consumes the cursor.
problems.evidence: adapters/sources/x.go reads q.Text, q.From, q.To and q.Limit but never q.Cursor, and captureSourcePageBound passes the persisted opaque_cursor into Query at internal/domain/sources.go:355-359 - so a second cycle would re-read the same search page and re-derive the same observed_tail, not resume from it. The receipt discloses that no second cycle was run; it does not disclose that the adapter would ignore the cursor if one were.
problems.why_not_a_blocker: The card claims persistence, and persistence is verified in the database by this reviewer (revision 2, opaque_cursor set, covered_until null, rev1 -> rev2 history). Claiming cross-cycle resume would be the overclaim; the receipt's not_verified_by_design names it as owed.
problems.required_before: Not required of this card. Any later claim that X resumes across cycles needs an adapter change plus a second capture; record this as the reason the disclosure is not yet sufficient for such a claim.

limitations: This reviewer did not re-execute the heavy suites the receipt lists as not_rerun (test.domain, test.runtime, test.security, test.resources, test.context, test.orchestration, test.ui.*, protocol.v2_roundtrip); the structural registry diff plus dispatcher.selftest 30, contracts.validate 136 and package.validate_v24 12 are what the append is covered by here.

The X leg was reproduced once end-to-end by this reviewer; the arXiv leg was reproduced once green and twice red, so the PAPER numbers quoted as green come from the executor's committed evidence, hash-verified but not re-earned here.
No cycle was advanced over these captures and no UI was driven, so findings about research.go and screens.jsx are read-and-reproduce-the-shape measurements, matching the card's own disclosure.

verdict_scope.OUTPUT - 三类来源各有真实成功或明确阻塞，健康/覆盖与UI一致: PARTIALLY MET. All three kinds are answered for real by the card's own command - GITHUB pending with cursor github-releases:v1:1:2, PAPER covered (in the executor's run; refused in this reviewer's), X 2 sealed posts with a pending cursor - and the X blockage is the product's own 503 RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, with GitHub and papers still reading while X is refused. '一致' holds at the capture layer (cursor pending iff page_complete false, no covered window without a complete page, asserted by W0702-*-NO-FALSE-COMPLETE and by the cursor rows this reviewer read out of SQLite). It does not hold at the cycle/UI layer: source_coverage as rendered from 来源覆盖 is never graded against these captures (see the executor's own disclosure and P/W0702-L1). Reservation R1 also lands here, because '各有真实成功' is not reproducible for PAPER at the command's own budget.
verdict_scope.NEGATIVE - 反例：X未配置却写空结果或明确阻塞缺失、引用一年旧文当近7: HALF MET. The X-unconfigured counter-example is exercised through the product path and fails closed in both directions (refusal is the 503, and the cursor does not advance), and no empty result is ever written as complete coverage - this reviewer additionally forced three absent-backend states and every one returned FAIL with the full roster. The year-old-as-recent counter-example is not exercised at all (reservation R2).
verdict_scope.EVIDENCE - 保存实际输入/代码/产物hash、命令/退出码和未通过项: MET. 17/17 registered evidence hashes, 5/5 capture reports and 28/28 manifest entries recompute from disk; commands are recorded with argv, exit codes, per-attempt item counts and the two red runs with their failure ids; the uncommitted 27 MB probe and the SQLite captures are declared as digested-not-preserved rather than claimed as kept; and this reviewer's own fresh run produced an independent evidence directory whose bytes recompute to the same hashes.
